title: LCARS Project Declaration
description: Structural schema for a per-project .lcars.json (template: priv/catalogue/cap_profile/config/declaration-template.json). Naming a validation card (pipeline_default) IS the criticality declaration — the card carries the whole gate (which judges, which CI, which verdict policy); there is no separate level. justification carries the WHY in prose (the framing interview: stakes of failure, lifetime — an agent NEVER self-assesses criticality; the architect relays the human). Underscore-prefixed keys are informational and ignored by the runtime.

max_fan.description: Workflow_runs this PROJECT may hold in flight at once. Absent = the fleet default (:fleet_pilot, :max_fan / --max-fan). The ceiling 15 mirrors Admission.max_fan_ceiling/0, which is the authority; the contracts check `declaration.max_fan_ceiling` refuses a divergence.
